name: postgres-database
title: PostgreSQL and relational data
summary: Model, query, migrate, tune, back up and scale a relational database, with PostgreSQL as the default: schemas, SQL, transactions, indexes, zero-downtime migrations, operations and recovery.
useWhen: Design the database schema for this feature
This query is slow, or the database CPU is pegged
Write a migration that will not lock the table or break the running app
Two requests raced and corrupted the data
We ran out of database connections
Set up backups and prove we can restore
Someone deleted production data and I need it back
Should I use an ORM or raw SQL, UUIDs or integer IDs?
When do I need a read replica, partitioning or a bigger instance?

notFor.topic: Redis, search engines, object storage, warehouses and other non-relational stores
Analytics queries, reporting SQL and statistics on business data
Choosing a multi-tenancy model and row-level tenant isolation
SQL injection and other vulnerability classes
Running the migration step inside the deploy pipeline
Company-wide disaster recovery plans, RPO and RTO
